---
title: "flexspan example"
subtitle: Pandoc/Quarto extension
filters:
  - flexspan
flexspan:
  # Styled rules: work in every output format, nothing else to define
  - left: "!!"
    color: red
  - left: "=="
    bg: yellow
  - left: "(("
    right: "))"
    color: "#1e90ff"
    bold: true
  # Colour chosen where it is used: -=text=-(blue)
  - left: "-="
    right: "=-"
  # Named rule: \custombox[opts]{..} in LaTeX, #custombox(..)[..] in Typst,
  # <span class="custombox"> in HTML, character style "custombox" in docx
  - left: "%%"
    command: custombox
format:
  html:
    css: flexspan-example.css
  pdf:
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          \newcommand{\custombox}[2][Dandelion]{\colorbox{#1}{#2}}
    keep-tex: true
  typst:
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          #let custombox(..args, body) = box(
            fill: eval(args.pos().at(0, default: "orange")),
            inset: (x: 3pt), outset: (y: 3pt), body)
  docx: default
---

## Colours: !!red heading!!

- Plain text with a !!red!! word and a ==highlighted== one.
- **Bold text with a !!red!! word**, *emphasis with a !!red!! word*,
  and !!red text with **bold** and *emphasis* inside!!.
- A rule can combine styles: ((blue and bold)).
- Colour given on the spot: -=green=-(green), -=white on navy=-(white, bg=navy),
  -=bold orange=-(orange, bold), -=hex=-(#8a2be2).
- Nested: !!red ==red on yellow== red!!.
- A [link with a !!red!! word](https://quarto.org) and a footnote^[With a !!red!! word.].

## Named commands

- Default: %%flexspan%% and with an option: %%flexspan%%(lime).

## Left alone

- Wow!! Great!! (delimiters glued to a word), `!!code!!`, $a!!b!!$ and
  [!!protected!!]{.skipspan}.

| Table      | Cell      |
|------------|-----------|
| !!red!!    | ==mark==  |
